mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_conversation (user_id, other_user_id, hidden, pinned, last_message_id, last_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{otherUserId}, #{hidden}, #{pinned}, #{lastMessageId}, #{lastAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hidden = VALUES(hidden), last_message_id = VALUES(last_message_id), last_at = VALUES(last_at)
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, u.user_id AS account, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.role AS role, cm.content AS lastMessage, cc.last_at AS lastAt, (cc.pinned = 1) AS pinned, (ub.id IS NOT NULL) AS blockedByMe, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE from_user_id = cc.other_user_id AND to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0) AS unreadCount FROM chat_conversation cc JOIN users u ON u.id = cc.other_user_id LEFT JOIN chat_message cm ON cm.id = cc.last_message_id LEFT JOIN user_block ub ON ub.blocker_id = #{userId} AND ub.blocked_id = cc.other_user_id WHERE cc.user_id = #{userId} AND cc.hidden = 0 ORDER BY cc.pinned DESC, cc.last_at DESC
SELECT * FROM chat_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND other_user_id = #{otherUserId}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_conversation SET hidden = #{hidden} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND other_user_id = #{otherUserId}
UPDATE chat_conversation SET pinned = #{pinned} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND other_user_id = #{otherUserId}
